The '''Holocron of Odan-Urr'''<ref name="Ossus" /> was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] constructed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] at some point before his [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The holocron, which contained his teachings, was lost sometime in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed, although it was rediscovered by the Jedi Master and [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Yuon Par]]<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> By [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="O-Time">{{TOR_updates|5.10.3}}</ref> the holocron was stored in the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] along with other [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifacts]], although its safety came under threat during the [[invasion of Ossus]] in that year.<ref name="Ossus" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Holocron of Odan-Urr was first mentioned, albeit unidentified, in the Codex entry for Yuon Par in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" /> It later appeared and was identified in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] "Jedi Under Siege" expansion as one of the items that [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] players must recover as part of the Daily quest "The Sacred Artifacts."<ref name="Ossus" />
